verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents several bulk operations: batch categorization of transactions, bulk CSV import of manual journal entries, and bulk add/edit of the Chart of Accounts via CSV. Custom rules and AI Close agents also reconcile and review transactions in aggregate. Missing for 10: evidence of bulk operations driven by AI agents via MCP or API (MCP is described only as conversational data access), detail on what batch categorization covers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
